newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer-thinks markets understood G7 statement.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-thinks markets understood G7 statement.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said on Thursday he had nothing to add to a statement issued after a meeting of Group of Seven (G7) finance ministers in early February in Berlin that the dollar had finished its correction.
"I have nothing to add to the Berlin message," he told journalists after a speech here. "The Berlin message was so clear that I am pretty sure that markets understood what was meant by that."
The G7 said after its meeting earlier this month that the sharp fall in the dollar seen in 1995 had been corrected, indicating they wanted the dollar to hold steady at the higher levels reached.
